opener_html:
Wade's narrowed the news.croquetqld.org rebuild to three refinements within one direction. They're side-by-side below — same news, same colours, same type, different decisions about density and photography. Open each in a new tab, look around for a couple of minutes, then come back here and rank them.

Each variant has the same content. We're not asking which content you like — we're asking which shape of news site you'd want to read every week.

variants.name: Ghost Source baseline
variants.tagline: The Ghost Source theme adapted to CAQ palette + type. Standard editorial density.
variants.diff: Drop caps on lead articles only. Body column at standard reading width. Three-column tile grid on the home page.

variants.name: Editorial-cranked
variants.tagline: Same bones as A, editorial typography dialled higher.
variants.diff: Drop caps on every article opener. Narrower body column. More frequent pull quotes. Hairline rules on every paragraph break.

variants.name: Photo-forward
variants.tagline: Same bones as A, photographs lead instead of headlines.
variants.diff: Article hero photos go full-bleed (instead of inline cover treatment). Home page leads with a single large featured-article photo (not a 3-column tile grid).
